summary: Updated every doc surface the slice's behavior touches: ArgoCDTools' README (rewritten for a two-image repo — the aac-tools commands and image, both kaniko stages, the three kc project components, the handover-equality check), the argo-cd migration set (design.md's repo cast, the ArgoCDTools section, the PreSync flow's image name and the ancillary-tooling note; decisions.md D31 and O2; phases.md's residual-tooling item), Ansible's CLAUDE.md (both images, and the Architecture repo P7 added to config.yaml), HelmCharts' aac-tools toolchain instructions (close-out B12 — they told an agent no repo needs a copy of arch-validate), and the three stale /work/ArgoCDTools/presync/… citations in ArgoCDDeploy and KubeCoderDeploy (close-out S3). Gates green: kc project lint+test in ArgoCDTools, ArgoCDDeploy and KubeCoderDeploy, kc project test plus a helm template of the kubecoder chart in HelmCharts, kc project lint in Ansible. Reconciled the counts that span scopes — the nine CA-root copies and ten md5 paths agree between decisions.md and the rotation runbook, all ten hash alike, the find cross-check's twelve is right, and the four terraform.rc copies agree. No claim was left unverified: the registry was queried for the argocd-hook and aac-tools tags, pipeline-producers.yaml for the absent deploy-repo producer, and the estate's arch-validate.py copies were re-hashed. Committed on phase/024-docs in Ansible and on main in the other five; nothing pushed. Close-out A5 records that ArgoCDDeploy and KubeCoderDeploy now carry commits the driver's sweep does not cover.
